tagline: One decision. Better questions. Clearer tradeoffs.

positioning.ideal_buyer: Founders and managers facing one defined, non-emergency business decision
positioning.buyer_problem: A decision matters and the alternatives, evidence gaps and assumptions are poorly understood.

delivery_contract.deliverable_to_scope: A written decision brief comparing agreed alternatives, assumptions, risks and open evidence questions
delivery_contract.buyer_inputs: Decision question, available non-sensitive facts, candidate options and existing analyses if any
delivery_contract.acceptance_criteria_to_agree: One decision, named alternatives, source boundaries, expected length and agreed review deadline
delivery_contract.exclusions: No live multi-model debate guarantee, board appointment, legal advice or guaranteed outcome

discovery_intents: AI second opinion on business decision
acquisition.content_angle: Confidence is cheap. A carefully challenged decision is worth more.
acquisition.approved_example_copy: Have one business decision you want pressure-tested? Evercraft AI Boardroom Standard offers a scoped $250 human-reviewed brief covering alternatives, risks and unanswered questions.
acquisition.distribution_rule: Use owned or authorized channels and qualified, permissioned audiences only. Do not claim posts, leads, conversion or revenue without source receipts.

evercraft_os.relationship: Independent market-facing product, sharing future Evercraft OS capabilities
evercraft_os.module_context: Evercraft OS / AI Boardroom (existing free comparison is separate from paid human review)

launch_evidence: Existing exact-price Stripe service page tested historically, with owner-shared buyer-view screenshots. This is not a new live purchase or automated delivery attestation.
